queries.query: "LLM" OR "large language model" AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "network operation" OR "network management") AND (error OR incorrect OR unsafe OR hallucination)
queries.rationale: Identify empirical reports and analyses of LLM mistakes when applied to NetOps (phenomenon: incorrect/unsafe config synthesis, hallucination in operational outputs).

queries.query: ("failure mode" OR "error mode" OR "misconfiguration") AND ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR "generative model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "configuration synthesis")
queries.rationale: Locate work characterizing mechanisms and failure modes behind model errors in network tasks (why/when errors occur).

queries.query: ("generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-validate" OR "generate-and-verify" OR "synthesize-verify-repair") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "generative AI") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Find papers and systems that use a generate→validate→repair pipeline or verifier-assisted generation for network configs (mitigation architectures).

queries.query: ("formal verification" OR "network verification" OR "header space analysis" OR Batfish OR Veriflow OR NetKAT) AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps) AND (verification OR correctness OR safety)
queries.rationale: Survey deterministic/formal tools used to validate network configurations and their suitability as validators for LLM outputs (benchmark/validator methods).

queries.query: ("intent to configuration" OR "intent-driven" OR "natural language to config" OR "NL2config" OR "intent translation") AND (network OR NetOps OR "router configuration" OR "firewall rules")
queries.rationale: Locate methods and datasets for translating operator intent (natural language) into concrete network configurations—key task family for this programme.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "agentic" OR "autonomous agent" OR "tool-augmented LLM" OR ReAct OR Toolformer) AND (network OR NetOps OR operations)
queries.rationale: Find literature on agentic or tool-augmented LLMs applied to operational workflows and orchestration (agentic workflows, tool invocation, guardrails).

queries.query: ("AIOps" OR "NetOps benchmark" OR "network benchmark" OR "OpsEval" OR "6G-Bench" OR TSNBench) AND (evaluation OR dataset OR benchmark)
queries.rationale: Gather existing benchmark suites and evaluation frameworks for AIOps/NetOps to assess benchmark validity and gaps (benchmark validity and external baselines).

queries.query: ("adversarial" OR "attacks" OR "prompt injection" OR "supply chain" OR "security") AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "configuration")
queries.rationale: Identify security and adversarial threats specific to LLM-driven NetOps (attacks on prompts, malicious config generation, poisoning).

queries.query: ("dataset" OR "corpus" OR repository) AND ("network configuration" OR "router configs" OR "firewall rules" OR "BGP configs") AND (public OR GitHub OR dataset)
queries.rationale: Find public datasets and configuration repositories usable as tasks/ground truth for experiments (data sources and provenance).

queries.query: ("evaluation methodology" OR "metric" OR "operational correctness" OR "safety metric" OR "validator metric") AND (LLM OR "generative AI") AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Locate prior work proposing operationally meaningful metrics, validators, or evaluation methods for LLM outputs in network contexts (construct validity).

queries.query: ("human-in-the-loop" OR "operator-in-the-loop" OR "human oversight") AND (LLM OR "generative model") AND (NetOps OR "network operations")
queries.rationale: Survey strategies combining human approval/oversight with automated generation to mitigate risk (mitigation via human supervision).

queries.query: ("case study" OR "field study" OR deployment) AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "generative AI") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network management")
queries.rationale: Seek real-world or deployed evaluations and their failure modes and mitigations to inform external validity and operational relevance.

inclusion_criteria: Primary-source publications (peer-reviewed conferences/journals) or preprints with clear provenance (arXiv)
Publicly accessible artifacts (code, datasets, reproducible configs) where available
Works explicitly addressing LLMs/generative models applied to network configuration, NetOps workflows, or automated network management
Papers on deterministic/formal network verification tools (Batfish, Veriflow, NetKAT, HSA) even if not LLM-focused (for validator mechanisms)
Benchmarks, datasets, or evaluation suites for AIOps/NetOps with published methodology and metrics
Security/adversarial analyses relevant to automated config generation or agentic workflows
Human-in-the-loop or operational studies that evaluate safety/trustworthiness in network contexts
Publications from 2010–2026, prioritizing 2018–2026 for LLM-era work but including older foundational verification/networking literature
exclusion_criteria: Purely generic NLP/LLM research with no application to network operations or configuration synthesis
Marketing blog posts, press releases, or vendor marketing lacking primary-data or reproducible artifacts (unless they link to datasets/code)
Non-public, proprietary, or paywalled artifacts with no accessible version or provenance
Pre-lock internal development artifacts from the programme or unpublished rehearsals
Works solely about unrelated domains (CV, speech) without cross-domain methodological transfer to NetOps
Benchmarks that only report model-language accuracy on trivia/network knowledge without operational validation (e.g., simple Q&A leaderboards)
Non-English publications unless an English translation or clear metadata exists
date_rationale: Cover foundational network verification literature dating back to 2010+ for validators and formal tools, but prioritize 2018–2026 for transformer/LLM-era studies and 2020–2026 for direct LLM→NetOps work. This window balances historical verification methods (pre-LLM) with the recent surge of generative-AI applied to operations, while ensuring coverage up to the CNSM 2026 deadline.
